displayName: CVF Model Gateway C-02 P4B-A provider execution bridge source
negativeSearchTerms: fetch (not in bridge - no live provider call)
notes: Deterministic provider-execution orchestration bridge. Connects existing routing, credential metadata, health, quota, and receipt owners to an injected provider-neutral adapter contract. Requires the injected adapter providerId to match the selected provider. Exports ProviderExecutionBridge, ProviderExecutionAdapter, ProviderExecutionAdapterInput, ProviderExecutionAdapterResult, ProviderExecutionBridgeOptions, ProviderExecutionBridgeResult, and PROVIDER_EXECUTION_BRIDGE_VERSION. No concrete provider binding, credential secret resolution, network call, or live proof.
